articles.title: Bengaluru int’l cricket stadium tender finalised
articles.description: The Karnataka Housing Board (KHB) has awarded the contract to the company for Rs 990.16 crore. The tender had been invited on April 8 with an estimated project cost of Rs 943.46 crore.

articles.title: Entrepreneurs seek permanent deployment of fire tenders at industrial areas in Ambala Cantt
articles.description: While industrial activities have been rising gradually, the absence of adequate fire safety infrastructure at the Industrial Growth Centre, Saha, and the HSIIDC Industrial Estate, Ambala Cantonment, has been a concern for industrialists. articles.title: Jewellers begin dispatches for ‘Thai Maaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam’
articles.description: With the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)-led government preparing to launch the ‘Thai Maaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam’, Joyalukkas Group and Kalyan Jewellers, the two jewellers awarded the tender for the scheme, have begun dispatching consignments from their facilities.
